  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech V Semester - Make up Examination - December - 2024  
  Natural Language Processing [CSE-3172]  
  Marks: 50                                                                            Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           List and recall different phases of Natural Language Processing with an example for  
  each.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate the morphological type like Noun phrase, Verb Phrase, Adjective Phrase for  
  the following sentences.  
  1. Important to Bill from the shop  
  2. Looked up the tree                                                                    (5)  
  3.The beautiful garden by the lake  
  4.The sky is blue in the day  
  5. I love to eat ice cream every day  
  
  C)      List and explain the key components to build a morphological parser.                     (2)  
  2)           Construct the Architecture of two-level cascade transducers using the combination of  
  FST Lexicon rules.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      Apply minimum edit distance algorithm and explain each step for the given inputs:  
  abcdef ↔ azced. Consider cost value for all the operation is 1.                          (3)  
  
  C)      Analyse the merits and demerits of stop word removal in the context of regular  
  expression. Implement the python code to illustrate the stop word removal for the given (4)  
  statement-"GOLDEN rays of SUNSHINE hit the CALM blue ocean."  
  
  3)           Explain the need of N-grams model with suitable examples. Describe the concept of  
  interpolation.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Apply rule-based tagging for the following sentence:  
  "The cat sat on the mat.".                                                               (3)  
  
  C)      List and explain the components of Hidden Markova Model(HMM )model.                      (2)  
  4)           Apply Noisy Channel Model to interpret the Noisy message "acress," which might be a      (5)
